column18:
Spend energy stored in your party's limit gauge to 
execute a powerful battle technique. The technique 
executed is determined by the role of the party member 
who initiates it.
Tank: Increase party defense (area of effect: 50y).
Melee: Single-target attack.
Ranged: Attack to all targets in a straight line (range: 
30y).
Caster: Area of effect attack (8y/10y/15y).
Healer: HP restoration. Raise at level 3 (area of effect: 
50y).
※If target is not weakened at the time of Raise, the 
target will be restored in a non-weakened state. If target 
is weakened at the time of Raise, the weakness counter 
will reset.
